# Peacock

> NBCUniversal’s streaming service for TV series, movies, live sports, live channels, and Spanish-language entertainment.

Peacock offers on-demand streaming across NBC, Bravo, Telemundo, Universal films, Peacock Originals, and major live sports properties. The site also includes browsing hubs for genres, collections, channels, plans, and customer support.

## Browse & Discover
- [Peacock Home](https://www.peacocktv.com/): Main entry point for browsing Peacock programming, plans, and featured live and on-demand content.
- [TV Shows](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-tv): Browse Peacock’s television catalog across drama, comedy, reality, crime, and more.
- [Movies](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-movies): Browse movies available on Peacock, including new releases, franchises, and genre collections.
- [Sports](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports): Explore Peacock’s live sports coverage, schedules, leagues, and event hubs.
- [Channels](https://www.peacocktv.com/channels): Access always-on streaming channels for news, sports, entertainment, and themed programming.
- [Collections](https://www.peacocktv.com/collections): Browse curated collections organized by franchise, brand, theme, and seasonal programming.

## TV Shows
- [Drama TV Shows](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-tv/drama): Drama series collection including network hits, crime stories, and serialized originals.
- [Comedy TV Shows](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-tv/comedy): Comedy series collection featuring sitcoms, sketch shows, and light entertainment.
- [Reality TV](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-tv/reality): Reality and unscripted programming from Peacock, Bravo, and related brands.
- [Crime TV Shows](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-tv/crime): Crime and procedural series collection with investigations, courtroom stories, and thrillers.
- [Kids TV Shows](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-tv/kids): Family and children’s television programming suitable for younger viewers.
- [Spanish-Language TV](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-tv/espanol): Spanish-language series and entertainment, including Telemundo programming.

## Movies
- [All Movies](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-movies): Main movies hub for featured films, genres, and curated recommendations.
- [Action Movies](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream/movies/action): Action film collection with franchise titles, thrillers, and adventure movies.
- [Comedy Movies](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream/movies/comedy): Comedy film collection spanning classics, recent releases, and family-friendly picks.
- [Drama Movies](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream/movies/drama-1): Drama film collection with award winners, biographical stories, and emotional narratives.
- [Horror Movies](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream/movies/horror): Horror movie collection featuring suspense, supernatural stories, and slasher titles.
- [Romantic Comedy Movies](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream/movies/romantic-comedy-movies): Romantic comedy collection with modern favorites and classic rom-coms.

## Sports
- [Sports Hub](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports): Central hub for Peacock sports programming, leagues, live events, and highlights.
- [Premier League](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports/premier-league): Premier League streaming hub with live matches, replays, and related coverage.
- [NFL on NBC](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports/nfl): NFL streaming hub for NBC games, special events, and football coverage.
- [WWE](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports/wwe): WWE hub for premium live events, archives, and wrestling programming.
- [Golf](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports/golf): Golf coverage hub with tournaments, featured groups, and related programming.
- [Olympics](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports/olympics): Olympics hub for event coverage, highlights, and multi-sport competition access.
- [College Basketball](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports/college-basketball): College basketball streaming hub with live games and tournament-related coverage.
- [Motorsports](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports/motorsports): Motorsports hub featuring racing events, highlights, and related series.

## Live Channels
- [Channels Hub](https://www.peacocktv.com/channels): Directory of Peacock’s live and always-on streaming channels.
- [NBC News NOW](https://www.peacocktv.com/watch/asset/channels/nbc-news-now/5f7f8f67d7d46c3f522b8b0f): Live news channel with breaking coverage and daily reporting.
- [TODAY All Day](https://www.peacocktv.com/watch/asset/channels/today-all-day/60d4f9a4b1f5d45f0c4f6f1d): Continuous lifestyle, interviews, and segments from the TODAY brand.
- [Sky News](https://www.peacocktv.com/watch/asset/channels/sky-news/5f7f8f67d7d46c3f522b8b10): International live news coverage and breaking updates.
- [NBC Sports](https://www.peacocktv.com/watch/asset/channels/nbc-sports/5f7f8f67d7d46c3f522b8b12): Sports-focused live channel with events, highlights, and studio programming.
- [SNL Vault](https://www.peacocktv.com/watch/asset/channels/snl-vault/60d4f9a4b1f5d45f0c4f6f20): Always-on channel featuring Saturday Night Live sketches and related content.

## Collections & Franchises
- [Wolf Entertainment](https://www.peacocktv.com/collections/wolf-entertainment): Collection for Law & Order, Chicago, and other Wolf Entertainment series.
- [Bravo Collection](https://www.peacocktv.com/collections/bravo): Bravo-focused collection of reality series, reunions, and related programming.
- [NBC Collection](https://www.peacocktv.com/collections/nbc): NBC programming collection spanning current shows, classics, and specials.
- [Telemundo Collection](https://www.peacocktv.com/collections/telemundo): Telemundo collection for Spanish-language series, reality, and novelas.
- [Hallmark Collection](https://www.peacocktv.com/collections/hallmark): Hallmark programming collection with movies and feel-good series.
- [True Crime Collection](https://www.peacocktv.com/collections/true-crime): Curated true crime collection of documentaries, docuseries, and investigations.

## Plans & Account
- [Plans and Pricing](https://www.peacocktv.com/plans/all-monthly): Subscription plans page with tier details and pricing information.
- [Redeem Offer](https://www.peacocktv.com/redeem): Redeem promotional codes or partner offers for Peacock subscriptions.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.peacocktv.com/gift-card): Information about Peacock gift cards and redemption options.
- [Sign In](https://www.peacocktv.com/signin): Account sign-in page for existing Peacock subscribers.
- [Create Account](https://www.peacocktv.com/start): Account creation and subscription onboarding flow.
- [Supported Devices](https://www.peacocktv.com/help/article/what-devices-and-platforms-are-supported-by-peacock): Device compatibility information for streaming Peacock.

- [Help Center](https://www.peacocktv.com/help): Main support hub for Peacock account, billing, and streaming questions.
- [Plans and Payments Help](https://www.peacocktv.com/help/category/plans-and-payments): Support articles about subscriptions, billing, and payment management.
- [Using Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/help/category/using-peacock): Help articles for profiles, playback, features, and app usage.
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.peacocktv.com/help/category/troubleshooting): Technical support articles for playback, app, and device issues.
- [Supported Devices Help](https://www.peacocktv.com/help/category/supported-devices): Device-specific setup and support documentation for Peacock apps.
- [Contact Us](https://www.peacocktv.com/help/article/contact-us-in-customer-service): Customer service contact options and support guidance.
